faqs.title: How do I create a new account?
faqs.details:
To create a new account:

1. Tap the **Sign Up** button on the welcome screen
2. Enter your email address
3. Choose a secure password
4. Verify your email through the link we send you
5. Complete your profile setup

Your account will be ready to use immediately after verification.

faqs.title: How do I reset my password?
faqs.details:
If you've forgotten your password:

1. Tap **Forgot Password** on the login screen
2. Enter your email address
3. Check your email for a reset link
4. Click the link and enter your new password
5. Confirm your new password

For security reasons, password reset links expire after 24 hours.

faqs.title: Can I use the app offline?
faqs.details:
Yes! The app supports **offline mode** with the following features:

- Access previously synced content
- Create and edit items locally
- View your saved favorites
- Changes sync automatically when you reconnect

*Note: Some features like real-time collaboration require an internet connection.*

faqs.title: How do I enable dark mode?
faqs.details:
Dark mode can be enabled in two ways:

**Automatic (Recommended):**
- Go to **Settings** → **Appearance**
- Select **System** to match your device settings

**Manual:**
- Go to **Settings** → **Appearance**
- Choose **Light** or **Dark**

The app will remember your preference across sessions.

faqs.title: Is my data secure?
faqs.details:
We take your privacy and security seriously:

✓ **End-to-end encryption** for sensitive data
✓ **Secure cloud backup** with AES-256 encryption
✓ **Two-factor authentication** available
✓ **Zero-knowledge architecture** - we can't access your encrypted data
✓ **Regular security audits** by independent firms

You can review our full security practices in Settings → Privacy & Security.

faqs.title: How do I export my data?
faqs.details:
To export your data:

1. Go to **Settings** → **Data Management**
2. Tap **Export Data**
3. Choose your preferred format:
   - **JSON** - Full data export
   - **CSV** - Spreadsheet compatible
   - **PDF** - Human-readable format
4. Select what to include (documents, settings, etc.)
5. Tap **Export** and choose where to save

Exports are generated immediately and include all your content.

faqs.title: What devices are supported?
faqs.details:
The app is available on:

**iOS:** Requires iOS 26.0 or later
- iPhone
- iPad

**macOS:** Requires macOS 26.0 or later
- Apple Silicon and Intel Macs

All your data syncs seamlessly across all your devices via iCloud.

faqs.title: How do I contact support?
faqs.details:
We're here to help! You can reach us through:

📧 **Email:** support@example.com (24-48 hour response time)
💬 **In-app chat:** Tap the chat icon in Settings
🐦 **Twitter:** @exampleapp
📖 **Help Center:** help.example.com

For urgent issues, use the in-app chat for the fastest response.

faqs.title: Can I share content with others?
faqs.details:
Yes! Sharing is easy:

**Individual Items:**
1. Tap the **Share** button on any item
2. Choose how to share (link, email, message)
3. Set permissions (view only or edit)

**Collections:**
1. Open a collection
2. Tap the three dots menu
3. Select **Share Collection**
4. Choose recipients and permissions

You can revoke access anytime from the sharing settings.

faqs.title: What are the subscription options?
faqs.details:
We offer flexible plans:

**Free:**
- Up to 100 items
- Basic features
- 1 GB storage

**Pro** ($4.99/month or $49.99/year):
- Unlimited items
- Advanced features
- 100 GB storage
- Priority support
- Offline mode

**Family** ($9.99/month or $99.99/year):
- Everything in Pro
- Up to 6 family members
- 500 GB shared storage
- Family sharing features

All plans include a **14-day free trial**!
